title: Define correctness before measuring performance
takeaway: 85 call labels changed. Evaluate local calls and complete tasks separately.

title: Unsupported inputs and missing dependencies drive errors
takeaway: 24/40 incorrect calls invent missing inputs. Counts include retries within a task.

title: Consistency is the strongest signal on these development tasks
takeaway:
The paired AUROC difference supports consistency over logprob;
the self-report advantage remains uncertain.

title: Rank steps for review; correction gains remain untested
takeaway:
Use the same strict budget of 39/198 steps.
Separate random-tie expectations from fixed-seed selections.

title: Internal calibration improves probability error, not ranking
takeaway: Task-grouped five-fold OOF reduces Brier error; the prior still has lower ECE.

title: New tasks expose probability shift and final-output failures
takeaway: Only one incorrect call was observed. Calibrated Brier does not beat the prior.

title: Stopped experiments clarified the next research steps
takeaway:
Reference prefixes lacked errors; thinking probes were slow;
synthetic stress data had no independent holdout evaluation.

title: Review budgets and scoring costs are different
takeaway: Every new candidate incurs three probes. Probe tokens equal 102.8% of primary tokens.

title: A callable prototype is ready; the research loop is incomplete
takeaway:
Pre-call probabilities and review flags work.
Stopping confidence, actual correction, and experience updates remain untested.
